title: Black Diaspora Cinema
description: Survey of Black cinematic expressions from the Americas, Europe and Africa as they articulate and negotiate racial, cultural and gendered identities. Analysis of these films will be related to specific national cinemas, narrative categories, representational strategies and aesthetic forms.

title: Black Film Production
description: This course is designed to teach students Black film history as a production workshop. Students will learn the technologies used by Black filmmakers from Oscar Micheaux to Ava DuVernay. The class will write and produce scenes on iMovie reflecting the styles and techniques of a particular period in Black film production.

title: Professional Development Seminar
description: Professional development seminar for majors and minors designed to strengthen students' reasoning, writing, and research skills. The seminar also assists majors and minors with skills needed in applying for jobs and graduate or professional school, as well as highlights how Black Studies will add value to occupational and educational objectives in a variety of areas upon graduating with a Bachelor’s degree.
prerequisites_raw: Upper-division standing. Two courses from BLST 1, 2, 3, 7 must be completed before enrolling in BLST 180.

title: Senior Thesis Seminar in Black Studies
description: Focus on producing a research proposal by identifying a research topic and research question, argumentation (why the study matters), methods and methodology, and literature search and review.
prerequisites_raw: Open to senior Black Studies majors who have completed most of the degree requirements.

title: Honors Thesis Seminar in Black Studies
description: Focus on producing a research proposal by identifying a research topic and research question, argumentation (why the study matters), methods and methodology, and literature search and review.
prerequisites_raw: By Department invitation only. Open to senior Black Studies majors who have completed most of the degree requirements.

title: Senior Thesis Seminar in Black Studies
description: Focus on method/methodology (in connection to data collection), data collection, and initial analysis of data.
prerequisites_raw: Open to senior Black Studies majors who have completed most of the degree requirements.

title: Honors Thesis Seminar in Black Studies

prerequisites_raw: By Department invitation only. Open to senior Black Studies majors who have completed most of the degree requirements.

title: Senior Thesis Seminar in Black Studies
description: Focus on continuing analysis and data discussion and completing the senior thesis.
prerequisites_raw: Open to senior Black Studies majors who have completed most of the degree requirements.

title: Honors Thesis Seminar in Black Studies
description: Focus on continuing analysis and data discussion, completing the senior honors thesis, and preparing to present an academic paper at the departmental Spring Colloquium for earning distinction (honors) in the major.
prerequisites_raw: By Department invitation only. Open to senior Black Studies majors who have completed most of the degree requirements.
